name: paper_cc_discharge_2C
comment: 2C full discharge to 2.80V (14A on cellAlex's 7Ah nominal capacity -- confirmed within cellAlex's own max_discharge_a (20A) and the EBC-A20's absolute hardware ceiling (20A), so it will run at the full requested 2C, not silently clamped), then 30 min rest with logging still on, then CC-CV recharge to full at 0.5C. Run 02a (0.5C) and 02b (1C) first, then this file. This is the run that excites the electrolyte/porosity parameters -- if it were unsafe on your cell/cycler you'd drop those from the fitted set, but on cellAlex it's within bounds.
